description: Log Redact & Secret Scanner API (restore): Detect and mask leaked API keys, JWTs, and private keys in logs, diffs, and prompts. (Endpoint: POST /v1/secret-scanner/restore)

redacted_text.description: Redacted text containing `[SECRET_*]` placeholder tokens to restore.

tokens.description: Caller-provided map of `[SECRET_*]` placeholder tokens (max 500 entries) to original secret values.

name: tinplate_secret_scanner_restore
